For every fixed d>=3, every E strictly between the clean spectral edges, and every nonnegative continuous compactly supported test function, the unfolded clean random regular graph eigenvalue process and the normalized GOE reference have asymptotically equal Laplace functionals along all admissible sizes.

The tree boundary messages are equivariant measurable functions of the iid environment, have positive imaginary parts, satisfy the cavity recursion, have the spatial moment and logarithmic covariance bounds in lem:tree-log, and satisfy E Im(m_o)=pi rho.

For every finite m, the marks plus independent conditional resolvent Gaussian noise F^eta satisfy H(F_star^eta|environment)-(d/2)H(F_edge^eta|environment) >= m[(1/2)log(2 pi e eta)-integral log|t-E-i eta| d nu(t)] at each prescribed positive height.

For every d>=3 and every finite m>=1, the inherited conditional entropy, tree-boundary regularity, invariant centered marked-law, and exact-second-moment hypotheses imply Law(U_o|environment)=N(0,Im(m_o)/(pi rho) I_m). No full universality conclusion is asserted.

For all real a,c_i and b_i>0, the boundary star covariance on a Z+sum X_i=0 has retained precision sum_i[((X_i+c_i Z)^2+b_i^2 Z^2)/b_i], determinant |m_o|^2 product b_i; an oriented edge has precision Q(g_i)+swap Q(g_prime) swap and determinant b_i Im(g_prime)/|1-g_i g_prime|^2.

For every environment with positive cavity imaginary parts, whitening the retained star and its edges gives coisometries R_i and positive endpoint weights A_oi with sum R_i^T A_oi R_i=I and A_oi+A_io=I in the same oriented edge coordinates; these identities remain true after tensoring with I_m.

Under the inherited covariance-convergence and logarithmic bounds, removal of the exact tree-equation residual and the Gaussian entropy constants turns the positive-height conditional entropy lower bound into E[H(L_o+gamma)-(1/2)sum_i H(R_i L_o+gamma)]>=0.

For each finite m, the weighted score equality at all re-rootings, the nonorthogonal spanning residual reading directions, and compatible nondegenerate edge laws force Gaussian conditional root marks and identify the spatial-color covariance structure.

Once compatible conditional Gaussian stars have covariance K tensor C(environment), ergodicity and re-rooting make C deterministic, and E U_o U_o^T=I_m forces C=(E Im(m_o))^(-1) I_m=(pi rho)^(-1) I_m.

import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace QuenchedRigidity

def dot {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (x y : A → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a, x a * y a

def tensor {S C : Type*} (a : S → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) : S → C → ℝ :=
  fun s c => a s * u c

def pairing {S C : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (x y : S → C → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s, ∑ c, x s c * y s c

def basis {C : Type*} [DecidableEq C] (c : C) : C → ℝ :=
  fun j => if j = c then 1 else 0

theorem dot_basis {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
    (u : C → ℝ) (c : C) : dot u (basis c) = u c := by
  simp [dot, basis, mul_ite]

theorem pairing_tensor {S C : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (a b : S → ℝ) (u v : C → ℝ) :
    pairing (tensor a u) (tensor b v) = dot a b * dot u v := by
  unfold pairing tensor dot
  calc
    (∑ s, ∑ c, (a s * u c) * (b s * v c)) =
        ∑ s, ∑ c, (a s * b s) * (u c * v c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      ring
    _ = (∑ s, a s * b s) * (∑ c, u c * v c) := by
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]

theorem block_pair_identity {S C I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (i j : I) (u v : C → ℝ) :
    dot (a i) (a j) * dot (D i u) v =
      dot (a i) (a j) * dot u (D j v) := by
  have h := hsym (tensor (a i) u) (tensor (a j) v)
  rw [hblock i u, hblock j v, pairing_tensor, pairing_tensor] at h
  exact h

theorem color_blocks_agree {S C I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    [DecidableEq C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i j, dot (a i) (a j) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j, D i = D j := by
  intro i j
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro u
  funext c
  have hij := block_pair_identity H a D hsym hblock i j u (basis c)
  have hjj := block_pair_identity H a D hsym hblock j j u (basis c)
  have h₁ := mul_left_cancel₀ (hnonzero i j) hij
  have h₂ := mul_left_cancel₀ (hnonzero j j) hjj
  simpa only [dot_basis] using h₁.trans h₂.symm

theorem common_block_on_sums {S C I : Type*}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype C] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i j, dot (a i) (a j) ≠ 0)
    (i₀ : I) (u : I → C → ℝ) :
    H (∑ i, tensor (a i) (u i)) =
      ∑ i, tensor (a i) (D i₀ (u i)) := by
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hblock i (u i), color_blocks_agree H a D hsym hblock hnonzero i i₀]

def edgeDiscriminant (b c u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - c * u + b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v + b * u) ^ 2

theorem one_sided_determinant (b c : ℝ) :
    (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * 1 - c * c = b ^ 2 := by
  ring

theorem one_sided_positive (b c z x : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hnonzero : z ≠ 0 ∨ x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ((x + c * z) ^ 2 + (b * z) ^ 2) / b := by
  apply div_pos _ hb
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · have hx : x ≠ 0 := hnonzero.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hz)
    simpa [hz] using sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx
  · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _)
      (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hb) hz))

theorem edge_determinant_scaled (b c u v : ℝ) :
    (v * (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + b) * (v + b * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) -
      (v * c + b * u) ^ 2 = b * v * edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_gap (b c u v : ℝ) :
    edgeDiscriminant b c u v =
      4 * b * v + (1 - c * u - b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v - b * u) ^ 2 := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_positive (b c u v : ℝ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hv : 0 < v) : 0 < edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  rw [edge_discriminant_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_pair_gap (B x y : ℝ) :
    (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y = B * (B - x - y) := by
  ring

theorem residual_pair_gap_positive (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hrest : 0 < B - x - y) :
    0 < (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y := by
  rw [residual_pair_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_off_diagonal_negative (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) : -(x * y) / B < 0 := by
  have h : 0 < x * y / B := by positivity
  linarith

theorem star_rank_one_scalar (S b P t : ℝ)
    (hB : S + b ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    (S + b) / P * (1 + (t ^ 2 / (S + b) + S) / b) =
      (t ^ 2 + (S + b) ^ 2) / (P * b) := by
  field_simp [hB, hb, hP]
  <;> ring

theorem edge_hessian_entry_constant {X : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (H : X → ℝ) (B D : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, q ^ 2 * H x + r ^ 2 * B = D) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  have heq : q ^ 2 * H x = q ^ 2 * H y := by
    linarith [h x, h y]
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) heq

theorem edge_hessian_constant {X C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (H : X → C → C → ℝ) (B D : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x i j, q ^ 2 * H x i j + r ^ 2 * B i j = D i j) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  funext i j
  exact edge_hessian_entry_constant r q hq (fun z => H z i j)
    (B i j) (D i j) (fun z => h z i j) x y

theorem edge_covariance_swap_entry (r q S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : ℝ)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (hcross : r * S₀ = r * S₁)
    (hleft : S₀ = r ^ 2 * S₁ + q ^ 2 * C₁)
    (hright : S₁ = r ^ 2 * S₀ + q ^ 2 * C₀) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  have h₀ : q ^ 2 * C₀ = q ^ 2 * S₁ := by
    linear_combination - hright - S₁ * hnorm - r * hcross
  have h₁ : q ^ 2 * C₁ = q ^ 2 * S₀ := by
    linear_combination - hleft - S₀ * hnorm + r * hcross
  exact ⟨mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₀,
    mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₁⟩

theorem edge_covariance_swap {C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : C → C → ℝ)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, r * S₀ i j = r * S₁ i j)
    (hleft : ∀ i j, S₀ i j = r ^ 2 * S₁ i j + q ^ 2 * C₁ i j)
    (hright : ∀ i j, S₁ i j = r ^ 2 * S₀ i j + q ^ 2 * C₀ i j) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  constructor
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).1
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).2

theorem two_step_covariance {V A : Type*} (adj : V → V → Prop)
    (S C : V → A)
    (hswap : ∀ u v, adj u v → C u = S v)
    (u v w : V) (huv : adj u v) (huw : adj u w) : S v = S w := by
  exact (hswap u v huv).symm.trans (hswap u w huw)

theorem covariance_normalization {C : Type*}
    (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (S Sigma : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i j, k * S i j = Sigma i j) :
    S = fun i j => Sigma i j / k := by
  funext i j
  apply (eq_div_iff hk).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using h i j

end QuenchedRigidity

    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i j, dot (a i) (a j) ≠ 0)
    (i₀ : I) (u : I → C → ℝ) :
    H (∑ i, tensor (a i) (u i)) =
      ∑ i, tensor (a i) (D i₀ (u i)) := by
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hblock i (u i), color_blocks_agree H a D hsym hblock hnonzero i i₀]

def edgeDiscriminant (b c u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - c * u + b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v + b * u) ^ 2

theorem one_sided_determinant (b c : ℝ) :
    (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * 1 - c * c = b ^ 2 := by
  ring

theorem one_sided_positive (b c z x : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hnonzero : z ≠ 0 ∨ x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ((x + c * z) ^ 2 + (b * z) ^ 2) / b := by
  apply div_pos _ hb
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · have hx : x ≠ 0 := hnonzero.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hz)
    simpa [hz] using sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx
  · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _)
      (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hb) hz))

theorem edge_determinant_scaled (b c u v : ℝ) :
    (v * (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + b) * (v + b * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) -
      (v * c + b * u) ^ 2 = b * v * edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_gap (b c u v : ℝ) :
    edgeDiscriminant b c u v =
      4 * b * v + (1 - c * u - b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v - b * u) ^ 2 := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_positive (b c u v : ℝ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hv : 0 < v) : 0 < edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  rw [edge_discriminant_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_pair_gap (B x y : ℝ) :
    (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y = B * (B - x - y) := by
  ring

theorem residual_pair_gap_positive (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hrest : 0 < B - x - y) :
    0 < (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y := by
  rw [residual_pair_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_off_diagonal_negative (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) : -(x * y) / B < 0 := by
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos (mul_pos hx hy)) hB

theorem star_rank_one_scalar (S b P t : ℝ)
    (hB : S + b ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    (S + b) / P * (1 + (t ^ 2 / (S + b) + S) / b) =
      (t ^ 2 + (S + b) ^ 2) / (P * b) := by
  field_simp [hB, hb, hP]
  ring

theorem edge_hessian_entry_constant {X : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (H : X → ℝ) (B D : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, q ^ 2 * H x + r ^ 2 * B = D) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  have heq : q ^ 2 * H x = q ^ 2 * H y := by
    linarith [h x, h y]
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) heq

theorem edge_hessian_constant {X C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (H : X → C → C → ℝ) (B D : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x i j, q ^ 2 * H x i j + r ^ 2 * B i j = D i j) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  funext i j
  exact edge_hessian_entry_constant r q hq (fun z => H z i j)
    (B i j) (D i j) (fun z => h z i j) x y

theorem edge_covariance_swap_entry (r q S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : ℝ)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (hcross : r * S₀ = r * S₁)
    (hleft : S₀ = r ^ 2 * S₁ + q ^ 2 * C₁)
    (hright : S₁ = r ^ 2 * S₀ + q ^ 2 * C₀) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  have h₀ : q ^ 2 * C₀ = q ^ 2 * S₁ := by
    linear_combination - hright - S₁ * hnorm - r * hcross
  have h₁ : q ^ 2 * C₁ = q ^ 2 * S₀ := by
    linear_combination - hleft - S₀ * hnorm + r * hcross
  exact ⟨mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₀,
    mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₁⟩

theorem edge_covariance_swap {C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : C → C → ℝ)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, r * S₀ i j = r * S₁ i j)
    (hleft : ∀ i j, S₀ i j = r ^ 2 * S₁ i j + q ^ 2 * C₁ i j)
    (hright : ∀ i j, S₁ i j = r ^ 2 * S₀ i j + q ^ 2 * C₀ i j) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  constructor
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).1
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).2

theorem two_step_covariance {V A : Type*} (adj : V → V → Prop)
    (S C : V → A)
    (hswap : ∀ u v, adj u v → C u = S v)
    (u v w : V) (huv : adj u v) (huw : adj u w) : S v = S w := by
  exact (hswap u v huv).symm.trans (hswap u w huw)

theorem covariance_normalization {C : Type*}
    (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (S Sigma : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i j, k * S i j = Sigma i j) :
    S = fun i j => Sigma i j / k := by
  funext i j
  apply (eq_div_iff hk).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using h i j

end QuenchedRigidity

claims.natural_statement: In a degree-five clean tree at energy zero, a fair environmental proper two-coloring is fully tree-automorphism ergodic but not parity-preserving ergodic. Scaling the canonical Gaussian reference by 1 and 2 on its two phases preserves the tree equation and conditional centering, has annealed root second moment one and D(s)=0 for all s>0, but conditional root variances 2/5 and 8/5. This is sharpness of the generalized ergodicity hypothesis, not a manuscript refutation.

The tree boundary messages are equivariant measurable functions of the iid environment, have positive imaginary parts, satisfy the cavity recursion, have the spatial moment and logarithmic covariance bounds in lem:tree-log, and satisfy E Im(m_o)=pi rho.
Almost every fixed empirical marked law is tree-automorphism invariant, has deterministic iid potential marginal, satisfies (V_v-E)U_v+sum_{u~v}U_u=0, E[U_v|environment]=0, and E U_o U_o^T=I_m.

For every finite m, the marks plus independent conditional resolvent Gaussian noise F^eta satisfy H(F_star^eta|environment)-(d/2)H(F_edge^eta|environment) >= m[(1/2)log(2 pi e eta)-integral log|t-E-i eta| d nu(t)] at each prescribed positive height.

For every d>=3 and every finite m>=1, the inherited conditional entropy, tree-boundary regularity, invariant centered marked-law, and exact-second-moment hypotheses imply Law(U_o|environment)=N(0,Im(m_o)/(pi rho) I_m). No full universality conclusion is asserted.

claims.natural_statement: For all real a,c_i and b_i>0, the boundary star covariance on a Z+sum X_i=0 has retained precision sum_i[((X_i+c_i Z)^2+b_i^2 Z^2)/b_i], determinant |m_o|^2 product b_i; an oriented edge has precision Q(g_i)+swap Q(g_prime) swap and determinant b_i Im(g_prime)/|1-g_i g_prime|^2.

For every environment with positive cavity imaginary parts, whitening the retained star and its edges gives coisometries R_i and positive endpoint weights A_oi with sum R_i^T A_oi R_i=I and A_oi+A_io=I in the same oriented edge coordinates; these identities remain true after tensoring with I_m.

Under the inherited covariance-convergence and logarithmic bounds, removal of the exact tree-equation residual and the Gaussian entropy constants turns the positive-height conditional entropy lower bound into E[H(L_o+gamma)-(1/2)sum_i H(R_i L_o+gamma)]>=0.

For each finite m, the weighted score equality at all re-rootings, the nonorthogonal spanning residual reading directions, and compatible nondegenerate edge laws force Gaussian conditional root marks and identify the spatial-color covariance structure.

Once compatible conditional Gaussian stars have covariance K tensor C(environment), ergodicity and re-rooting make C deterministic, and E U_o U_o^T=I_m forces C=(E Im(m_o))^(-1) I_m=(pi rho)^(-1) I_m.

Parity-ergodic quenched entropy rigidity: for every d>=3 and finite m, let an invariant marked field satisfy the tree eigen-equation, conditional centering and finite annealed second-moment matrix Sigma. Let compatible equivariant boundary-Green star covariances K come from positive cavity imaginary parts, with finite kappa=E k_o>0 and E log(1+||K_ret^(-1)||)<infinity. If the once-smoothed whitened star-minus-half-edge entropy is nonnegative and the environment is ergodic under parity-preserving tree automorphisms, the conditional retained-star law is N(0,K_ret tensor Sigma/kappa). Edge correlations may vanish; no atomlessness, uniform distribution, weak disorder, or iid hypothesis is imposed. The analytic proof and novelty await independent review.

For arbitrary finite spatial and color index sets, a self-adjoint linear operator preserving every nonorthogonal tensor color block induces the same color operator on every generating block. For all real edge rotation parameters r,q with q nonzero, a constant reverse-endpoint complementary Hessian forces a constant central Hessian, including r=0; compatible endpoint covariance equations imply the universal covariance swap. Exact scalar precision discriminants, residual Gram gaps, rank-one determinant simplification, two-step covariance propagation, and covariance normalization hold under their explicitly stated nonzero or positive denominators.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace QuenchedRigidity

def dot {A : Type*} [Fintype A] (x y : A → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a, x a * y a

def tensor {S C : Type*} (a : S → ℝ) (u : C → ℝ) : S → C → ℝ :=
  fun s c => a s * u c

def pairing {S C : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (x y : S → C → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ s, ∑ c, x s c * y s c

def basis {C : Type*} [DecidableEq C] (c : C) : C → ℝ :=
  fun j => if j = c then 1 else 0

theorem dot_basis {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C]
    (u : C → ℝ) (c : C) : dot u (basis c) = u c := by
  simp [dot, basis, mul_ite]

theorem pairing_tensor {S C : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (a b : S → ℝ) (u v : C → ℝ) :
    pairing (tensor a u) (tensor b v) = dot a b * dot u v := by
  unfold pairing tensor dot
  calc
    (∑ s, ∑ c, (a s * u c) * (b s * v c)) =
        ∑ s, ∑ c, (a s * b s) * (u c * v c) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      ring
    _ = (∑ s, a s * b s) * (∑ c, u c * v c) := by
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]

theorem block_pair_identity {S C I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (i j : I) (u v : C → ℝ) :
    dot (a i) (a j) * dot (D i u) v =
      dot (a i) (a j) * dot u (D j v) := by
  have h := hsym (tensor (a i) u) (tensor (a j) v)
  rw [hblock i u, hblock j v, pairing_tensor, pairing_tensor] at h
  exact h

theorem color_blocks_agree {S C I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype C]
    [DecidableEq C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i j, dot (a i) (a j) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j, D i = D j := by
  intro i j
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro u
  funext c
  have hij := block_pair_identity H a D hsym hblock i j u (basis c)
  have hjj := block_pair_identity H a D hsym hblock j j u (basis c)
  have h₁ := mul_left_cancel₀ (hnonzero i j) hij
  have h₂ := mul_left_cancel₀ (hnonzero j j) hjj
  simpa only [dot_basis] using h₁.trans h₂.symm

theorem common_block_on_sums {S C I : Type*}
    [Fintype S] [Fintype C] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq C]
    (H : (S → C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (S → C → ℝ))
    (a : I → S → ℝ)
    (D : I → (C → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (C → ℝ))
    (hsym : ∀ x y, pairing (H x) y = pairing x (H y))
    (hblock : ∀ i u, H (tensor (a i) u) = tensor (a i) (D i u))
    (hnonzero : ∀ i j, dot (a i) (a j) ≠ 0)
    (i₀ : I) (u : I → C → ℝ) :
    H (∑ i, tensor (a i) (u i)) =
      ∑ i, tensor (a i) (D i₀ (u i)) := by
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hblock i (u i), color_blocks_agree H a D hsym hblock hnonzero i i₀]

def edgeDiscriminant (b c u v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - c * u + b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v + b * u) ^ 2

theorem one_sided_determinant (b c : ℝ) :
    (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * 1 - c * c = b ^ 2 := by
  ring

theorem one_sided_positive (b c z x : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hnonzero : z ≠ 0 ∨ x ≠ 0) :
    0 < ((x + c * z) ^ 2 + (b * z) ^ 2) / b := by
  apply div_pos _ hb
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · have hx : x ≠ 0 := hnonzero.resolve_left (not_not.mpr hz)
    simpa [hz] using sq_pos_of_ne_zero hx
  · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _)
      (sq_pos_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hb) hz))

theorem edge_determinant_scaled (b c u v : ℝ) :
    (v * (c ^ 2 + b ^ 2) + b) * (v + b * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) -
      (v * c + b * u) ^ 2 = b * v * edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_gap (b c u v : ℝ) :
    edgeDiscriminant b c u v =
      4 * b * v + (1 - c * u - b * v) ^ 2 + (c * v - b * u) ^ 2 := by
  unfold edgeDiscriminant
  ring

theorem edge_discriminant_positive (b c u v : ℝ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hv : 0 < v) : 0 < edgeDiscriminant b c u v := by
  rw [edge_discriminant_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_pair_gap (B x y : ℝ) :
    (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y = B * (B - x - y) := by
  ring

theorem residual_pair_gap_positive (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hrest : 0 < B - x - y) :
    0 < (B - x) * (B - y) - x * y := by
  rw [residual_pair_gap]
  positivity

theorem residual_off_diagonal_negative (B x y : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 < B) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) : -(x * y) / B < 0 := by
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_neg_of_pos (mul_pos hx hy)) hB

theorem star_rank_one_scalar (S b P t : ℝ)
    (hB : S + b ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    (S + b) / P * (1 + (t ^ 2 / (S + b) + S) / b) =
      (t ^ 2 + (S + b) ^ 2) / (P * b) := by
  field_simp [hB, hb, hP]
  ring

theorem edge_hessian_entry_constant {X : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (H : X → ℝ) (B D : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x, q ^ 2 * H x + r ^ 2 * B = D) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  have heq : q ^ 2 * H x = q ^ 2 * H y := by
    linarith [h x, h y]
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) heq

theorem edge_hessian_constant {X C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (H : X → C → C → ℝ) (B D : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x i j, q ^ 2 * H x i j + r ^ 2 * B i j = D i j) :
    ∀ x y, H x = H y := by
  intro x y
  funext i j
  exact edge_hessian_entry_constant r q hq (fun z => H z i j)
    (B i j) (D i j) (fun z => h z i j) x y

theorem edge_covariance_swap_entry (r q S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : ℝ)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (hcross : r * S₀ = r * S₁)
    (hleft : S₀ = r ^ 2 * S₁ + q ^ 2 * C₁)
    (hright : S₁ = r ^ 2 * S₀ + q ^ 2 * C₀) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  have h₀ : q ^ 2 * C₀ = q ^ 2 * S₁ := by
    linear_combination - hright - S₁ * hnorm - r * hcross
  have h₁ : q ^ 2 * C₁ = q ^ 2 * S₀ := by
    linear_combination - hleft - S₀ * hnorm + r * hcross
  exact ⟨mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₀,
    mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hq) h₁⟩

theorem edge_covariance_swap {C : Type*}
    (r q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hnorm : r ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (S₀ C₀ S₁ C₁ : C → C → ℝ)
    (hcross : ∀ i j, r * S₀ i j = r * S₁ i j)
    (hleft : ∀ i j, S₀ i j = r ^ 2 * S₁ i j + q ^ 2 * C₁ i j)
    (hright : ∀ i j, S₁ i j = r ^ 2 * S₀ i j + q ^ 2 * C₀ i j) :
    C₀ = S₁ ∧ C₁ = S₀ := by
  constructor
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).1
  · funext i j
    exact (edge_covariance_swap_entry r q (S₀ i j) (C₀ i j) (S₁ i j)
      (C₁ i j) hq hnorm (hcross i j) (hleft i j) (hright i j)).2

theorem two_step_covariance {V A : Type*} (adj : V → V → Prop)
    (S C : V → A)
    (hswap : ∀ u v, adj u v → C u = S v)
    (u v w : V) (huv : adj u v) (huw : adj u w) : S v = S w := by
  exact (hswap u v huv).symm.trans (hswap u w huw)

theorem covariance_normalization {C : Type*}
    (k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (S Sigma : C → C → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i j, k * S i j = Sigma i j) :
    S = fun i j => Sigma i j / k := by
  funext i j
  apply (eq_div_iff hk).2
  simpa [mul_comm] using h i j

end QuenchedRigidity

A nonnegative D(1) therefore forces score equality without inverse-weight moment assumptions.
